csv_project_name: CMAR for DMC Enabling Central Utility Plant & Infrastructure
csv_agency: University of Texas at Austin - Purchasing
csv_scope_of_work: The University of Texas at Austin (Owner) is soliciting proposals (Proposals) for the selection of a Construction Manager-at-Risk for Capital Planning and Construction Project No. 102-1611 Dell Medical Center at Austin, Texas Enabling Central Utility Plant and Infrastructure (Project). The project consists of the development of a Central Utility Plant and associated utility infrastructure at the Dell Campus for Advanced Research located on approximately 5-8 acres to the west of Stonelake Boulevard. This project includes construction of a central utility plant facility sized to support both equipment and operational support functions. The CUP facility will be designed to integrate with the architectural character of campus and surrounding development. The facility will incorporate appropriate architectural expressions and materials to align with campus design standards ensuring a cohesive built environment.
